scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 native RBAC on two case-owned namespaced CRDs in one synthetic API group. The ML service account receives create/get/list/watch/update/patch/delete only on modelruns in saf-0401-004; trainingruns, modelruns/status, and modelruns in another namespace are outside that grant. A distinct synthetic admin actor has an explicit namespaced role for both fixture resources. No operator controller, real AI CRD, admission policy, workload, or production identity mapping is present.

checks.claim: The broad fixture grant allows create, update and delete on the second custom resource
The exact namespaced Role permits the ML actor to create, update, and delete the granted synthetic resource
The same actor is forbidden from create, update, and delete on the other CRD, from update in another namespace, and from writing the status subresource
